name: GRC-Tool (Compliance OS)
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1; corepack enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.3 --activate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
start: sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start || true; for i in $(seq 1 30); do pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='grc'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE ROLE grc LOGIN"; sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='grc'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres createdb -O grc grc; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; export DATABASE_URL="postgres://grc@localhost:5432/grc"; cd /workspace && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push

terminals.name: api-server
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; export DATABASE_URL="postgres://grc@localhost:5432/grc"; export PORT=8080; export NODE_ENV=development; cd /workspace && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev
terminals.description: Express API server on http://localhost:8080 (routes served under /api). Requires DATABASE_URL and PORT.

terminals.name: grc-tool
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; export PORT=5173; export BASE_PATH=/; export API_PROXY_TARGET="http://localhost:8080"; cd /workspace && pnpm --filter @workspace/grc-tool run dev
terminals.description: Vite React SPA 'Compliance OS' on http://localhost:5173. Proxies /api to the API server via API_PROXY_TARGET (dev-only).
